title: New Phlan (Civilized Area)
prerequisites: A party has been created (up to six characters) and the game started; the GOG code wheel accepts any answer.
No commission is needed to be here; this is the hub every other area returns to.
Scenarios about later states name their own preconditions (Sokal Keep cleared, Yarash defeated, tracker count, Party Strength, town anger).
XP figures assume exactly six characters.
Shops and City Hall are open by day only: dawn 00:00, dusk 14:00.

scenarios.title: Pass the code wheel with any answer
steps: Start the game. The copy-protection question appears (an Espruar rune, a Dethek rune and a path).
Type any text, including a wrong word, and confirm.
expect: The game continues to the main menu whatever was typed.
One random number is drawn to pick the question (Random(13)) before any other game dice.
data: 13 six-letter words in START.EXE, from 'BEWARE' to 'WYVERN'
sources: [P] §4 mechanics (qa/research/guides-digest.md) UI and files: copy protection
scenarios.notes: 1.3-specific: in the GOG program the branch after the comparison is patched so every answer is accepted (qa/research/code-wheel.md). The extra Random(13) draw shifts every later die by one relative to the first release (qa/research/version-1.3-differences.md); replays with fixed dice depend on it. [P] lists copy-protection removal among patches that should not be applied; here the shipped GOG binary is the reference, so 'accept anything' is the faithful behaviour for Classic.

scenarios.title: Follow Rolf's guided tour
steps: Start a new game with a party. The party appears at E1 (15,1).
The game prints ''GREETINGS, COURAGEOUS ONES, I AM ROLF, APPOINTED BY THE COUNCIL TO INTRODUCE NEWCOMERS TO THE FAIR CITY OF PHLAN. IF YOU WILL ACCOMPANY ME, I WILL START THE TOUR.''
''YOU NOW FACE AN ENTRANCE TO THE TEMPLE OF TYR. THERE ARE THREE TEMPLES IN PHLAN: TYR'S, SUNE'S, AND TEMPUS. TYR'S IS THE LARGEST AND HOUSES BISHOP BRACCIO. IF YOU WILL TURN AROUND NOW, ''
''YOU WILL SEE THE ENTRANCE TO THE PASSENGER DOCK AREA WE JUST DEPARTED. FEW SHIPS DARE THE PERILOUS PASSAGE HERE, BUT THE COUNCIL IS DEVELOPING A PLAN TO OPEN UP THE SEA LANES. PLEASE FOLLOW ME.''
''BEHIND THESE DOORS ARE THE SPECIAL TRAINING SCHOOLS WHERE ADVENTURERS INCREASE THEIR SKILLS. LET US NOW GO TO THE CITY'S MOST IMPORTANT BUILDING.''
''WE ARE JUST OUTSIDE THE CITY HALL. PROCLAMATIONS ARE POSTED ON THESE WALLS. INSIDE, THE CITY CLERK AWARDS THE COUNCIL'S COMMISSIONS. COMMISSIONS ARE THE QUICKEST WAY TO FAME AND FORTUNE.''
''ON YOUR RIGHT IS ONE OF THE ENTRANCE'S TO SUNE'S TEMPLE. AS WITH ALL PHLAN'S TEMPLES, VARIOUS CLERICAL SERVICES ARE OFFERED INSIDE. ON YOUR LEFT IS AN ENTRANCE TO THE CITY PARK.''
''BEYOND THIS GATE ARE THE MONSTER-RIDDEN AREAS OF THE OLD CITY WE ARE SLOWLY PREPARING FOR SETTLEMENT. THE COUNCIL OFFERS A GENEROUS REWARD TO THOSE WHO CLEAR AREAS OF MONSTERS.'
''OUR TOUR IS ENDED. AGAIN, LET ME URGE YOU TO APPLY TO THE CITY CLERK FOR A COMMISSION. GOOD-BYE AND GOOD FORTUNE.' (YOU ARE ON YOUR OWN NOW)'
expect: The tour ends with the party at E2 (0,4), the gate to the Slums.
The eight texts print in the order above.
The tour does not repeat on a later entry to New Phlan.
coveredBy: verifyFreshSlumsVictory (milestone 'Created six characters, completed Rolf's tour, saved and reloaded, and entered the Slums.')
verifyOpeningReload
scenarios.notes: The digest says only 'a brief guided tour, which will end at E2'. It does not say whether the player moves the party or is carried, or whether the tour can be declined; the text order is the script order. [P]'s suggested first steps after the tour: buy melee weapons, armor and shields; stay at an inn to memorize spells; visit the clerk. Taverns are dangerous for new characters. Established by npm run acceptance:new-phlan: the player does not move the party and cannot decline; each text waits for Return and the game carries the party from (15,1) to (0,4). 'Does not repeat' is proved twice: coming back out of City Hall (which reloads the New Phlan script) and loading a game saved after the tour. The script starts the tour only while its flag is unset (ECL3.DAX block 0 at 9b40: COMPARE 0x4ac5, 1; IF < GOTO b071, which sets 0x4ac5 to 1).

scenarios.title: At the start only the Slums and Sokal Keep are offered and reachable
steps: Right after the tour visit the council clerk at City Hall 29 (5,5).

She prints ''BEFORE I CAN OFFER ANY COMMISSIONS, I MUST SEE IF YOU ARE DUE A CURRENT REWARD.' then 'THE CLERK SHUFFLES THROUGH HER PAPERS. 'ON THE MATTER OF COMMISSION,' SHE SAYS, 'I CAN OFFER THE FOLLOWING: ''

She lists 'THE SLUMS IMMEDIATELY TO OUR WEST NEED TO BE CLEARED OF MONSTERS.'', 'SOKAL KEEP ON THORN ISLAND MUST BE CLEARED.'' and third 'THE COUNCIL IS OFFERING A REWARD FOR BOOKS, MAPS, TOMES, ETC. WHICH PROVIDE USEFUL INFORMATION ABOUT PHLAN BEFORE THE FALL. THE REWARD IS TIED TO THE VALUE OF THE INFORMATION.'', then ''THESE ARE ALL OF THE COMMISSIONS CURRENTLY AVAILABLE.''
Go to the dock at (11,1): the only boat goes to Sokal Keep.
Walk west out of the gate at (0,4): the game prints 'YOU HAVE ENTERED THE MONSTER-CRAWLING SLUMS OF PHLAN. SMALL, UGLY THINGS SCURRY FROM BENEATH YOUR FEET. IN THE DISTANCE, AN ALARM SOUNDS.'
expect: The first visit offers three commissions: the Slums, Sokal Keep and, third, the reward for books (commission #3).
The Slums (west gate) and Sokal Keep (boat) are the only areas reachable without passing through another hostile block.
disagreements: [P] says 'At first only the Slums and Sokal Keep commissions are mentioned' and also that the clerk 'offers the first three unresolved commissions on her list'. The third on the list is #3 (books). Whether the first visit lists two or three offers must be read from the script.
coveredBy: verifySokalArrival (milestone 'Heard the council's commissions, took the boat to Sokal Keep and reloaded the arrival in slot A.')
scenarios.notes: Corrected from the game (npm run acceptance:new-phlan): the first visit lists three offers, not two. The clerk's loop offers commissions in list order until three have been offered (ECL3.DAX block 8 at a845: COMPARE 0x4a05, 2; IF > GOTO af4b), and #3 (books) is unresolved at the start. 'Only areas reachable' is proved as the two ways out: one step west of the gate is the Slums, and the harbor master offers one boat, which lands at Sokal Keep; the New Phlan script leaves town nowhere else before Sokal Keep is cleared (block 0: NEW ECL 20 at 9962 for walking off the map, NEW ECL 21 at 9bf1 for the boat).

scenarios.title: Train a character at the right hall for 1000 gold
steps: Enter the training complex. The game prints 'NOTICES FOR TEACHERS AND STUDENTS ARE POSTED ON THE WALLS. A NOTE DIRECTS MAGIC USERS AND CLERICS TO GO NORTH AND FIGHTERS AND 'ROGUES' TO GO EAST.'

Further signs: 'A SIGN ON THE WALL DIRECTS MAGIC USERS TO GO THROUGH THE EAST DOOR AND CLERICS TO GO THROUGH THE WEST DOOR.'; 'A SIGN ON THE NORTH DOOR READS 'FIGHTERS'.'; 'A SIGN ON THE NORTH DOOR READS 'ROGUES'.'
Enter a hall: cleric HC (5,0), magic-user HM (7,0), fighter HF (8,0), thief HT (9,0). The trainer says ''WE TRAIN ONLY <class> HERE. DO YOU WANT TO TRAIN?'' with YES / NO.
Choose YES with a character of that class who has enough XP for the next level and 1000 gold (200 platinum).
expect: The character gains exactly one level.
1000 gold (or 200 platinum) is deducted.
XP beyond the next threshold is cut to 1 below the level after.
A character of another class, or without the XP, is not trained.
data: Level 2 thresholds: cleric 1,501; fighter 2,001; magic-user 2,501; thief 1,251
Hit dice: cleric d8, fighter d10, magic-user d4, thief d6
disagreements: Clue Book p.3-4 numbers New Phlan 1-24 (for example 3 Temple of Tyr, 5 Dueling & Hiring Hall, 12 City Hall entrance, 13 Clerk, 19 Inns, 20 Taverns); [P] uses different numbers (2 dock, 5 Braccio, 6 Tyr, 7 Sune, 14 hall, 24 Tempus, 26-34 City Hall). The numbers do not line up.
coveredBy: verifyFighterTrainingJournal
milestone 'Trained Darkstar to level 2, paid for lodging, and reloaded Magic Missile memorized.'
scenarios.notes: Refusal texts for the wrong class or too little XP or money are engine messages not in the script text; the digest does not quote them. Platinum is accepted wherever gold is asked ([P] §4).

scenarios.title: Training-hall save and roster exploits
steps: Re-roll hit points: at a training hall Save, train, Drop everyone, Load; the level-up hit points are rolled again.
Duplicate items: Remove one character, Save, create a dummy, trade items to the dummy, Remove the dummy, Drop everyone else, Load the save, Add the dummy back.
Restart with characters: Remove everyone, Quit, restart, Add; the characters keep XP, items and money.
expect: Each sequence works as described: a different hit-point roll after reload (with different dice), two copies of the traded items, and a fresh game world with the old characters.
sources: [P] §4 mechanics (qa/research/guides-digest.md) UI and files ('Loading is only possible from the main menu, or after dropping everyone at a training hall'; 'Loading a save deletes any characters previously Removed')
scenarios.notes: These are properties of the roster and save system that surface at the halls. A faithful port must not block them. With fixed dice the hit-point re-roll gives the same result; the runner must vary the dice to observe a change.

scenarios.title: Rest at an inn for 1 platinum
steps: Enter an inn (IN). The innkeeper says ''IT WILL COST YOU 1 PLATINUM PIECE TO REST HERE. DO YOU WANT TO STAY?''
Choose YES with a character who holds at least 1 platinum.
Rest for as long as wished, memorizing spells.
expect: 1 platinum is deducted for the whole party.
The rest is never interrupted.
Spells chosen are memorized; hit points heal at 1 per 24 hours.
branches: Payer has too little: 'YOU DON'T HAVE ENOUGH PLATINUM.'
Payer cannot pay: 'THAT PERSON WON'T PAY.' (trigger not described in the digest; likely an NPC as payer).
sources: Clue Book p.3-4 'Where You Can Rest' and location 19
coveredBy: milestone 'Trained Darkstar to level 2, paid for lodging, and reloaded Magic Missile memorized.'
scenarios.notes: The digest gives no coordinates for the inns.

scenarios.title: Rest at an inn while the town refuses service
steps: Fight the city guard so that service is refused.
Enter an inn. The game prints ''DUE TO YOUR VICIOUS ATTACK ON THOSE WHO PROTECT US, WE REFUSE YOU ALL SERVICE.''
Rest anyway.
expect: The refusal text is shown, yet the party can still rest at the inn without interruption.
sources: [P] §3.0 (qa/research/guides-digest.md) ('If the town is angry you are told you are denied service, but you can still rest (a bug)')
scenarios.notes: Faithful-port behaviour. The digest does not say whether the platinum is still charged.

scenarios.title: Buy from the four kinds of shop by day
steps: By day enter the arms and armor shop (SA): 'THE SHOP SPECIALIZES IN ARMS AND ARMOR. 'CAN I SHOW YOU OUR WARES?''
Enter the general store (SG): 'THE SHOPKEEPER GREETS YOU AND OFFERS YOU ITEMS FOR SALE. 'CAN I SHOW YOU SOMETHING?''
Enter the jeweler (SJ) at (8,10): 'THE SHOPKEEPER OFFERS JEWELRY FOR SALE. 'CAN I SHOW YOU SOMETHING?''
Enter the silver shop (SS): 'THE SHOP SELLS SILVER ITEMS. 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO SEE OUR SELECTION?''
Buy an item, sell an item, and have an item identified.
expect: General store stock: mirrors, holy symbols, flasks of oil, vials of holy water.
Silver shop stock: silver weapons and armor, and the Fine Composite Long Bow at 25000 gold.
Selling pays half of value; arrows and bolts 5%. Sale proceeds are converted to platinum and the gold remainder is lost.
Identification costs 200 gold.
data: Sell at half value; arrows and bolts 5%
Doors the test uses: general store entered at (9,10) from (10,10); silver shop at (11,10) from (11,9)

General store list as the game shows it (gold): Brass Mirror 10, Silver Mirror 20, 1 Flask of Oil 1, Wooden Holy Symbol Of Tyr 1, Iron Holy Symbol Of Tempus 2, Silver Holy Symbol Of Sune 50, 1 Holy Water vial 25

Silver shop list as the game shows it (gold): Silver Mace 80, Silver Bastard Sword 250, Silver Broad Sword 100, Silver Long Sword 150, Silver Short Sword 80, Silver Two-Handed Sword 300, 1 Silver Dagger 20, 20 Silver Arrows 20, 1 Silver Quarrel 20, Silver Chain Mail 750, Silver Plate Mail 4000, Silver Ring 90, Fine Composite Long Bow 25000
disagreements: Holy symbol: [P] the Wooden Holy Symbol of Tyr (or a mirror) repels vampires and 'The holy symbols of Sune and Tempus have no function'; Clue Book p.4 'The wooden holy symbol of Tempus is a good buy because ... his symbol will repel vampires' (digest §7 item 17).
Jewelry value: [P] 100-11999 gold; Clue Book p.4 '75-50,000 gold pieces' (digest §7 item 18).
Silver shop: Clue Book p.4 adds 'silver jewelry'; [P] lists silver weapons, armor and the bow.

Clue Book p.3-4 numbers New Phlan 1-24 (for example 3 Temple of Tyr, 5 Dueling & Hiring Hall, 12 City Hall entrance, 13 Clerk, 19 Inns, 20 Taverns); [P] uses different numbers (2 dock, 5 Braccio, 6 Tyr, 7 Sune, 14 hall, 24 Tempus, 26-34 City Hall). The numbers do not line up.
coveredBy: verifyFreshSlumsVictory (milestone 'Bought and readied hand axes and chain mail for all six fighters, then verified the gear after reloading slot B.')
verifyGoblinLootSale
milestone 'Bought and readied a long bow and arrows in New Phlan, then verified both after reload.'
scenarios.notes: The digest gives coordinates only for the jeweler and for one arms-shop door (9,14). Shops are open by day only: dawn 00:00, dusk 14:00 ([P] §4). [P] §5: coin totals over 65535 gold (13107 pp) can be lost in a transaction. npm run acceptance:new-phlan walks the general store and the silver shop and asserts their greetings and stock (first two expectations); buying, selling and identifying are not yet tested, so the scenario stays open.

scenarios.title: The arms shop door at (9,14) works at night
steps: Wait until night (after 14:00).
Walk through the arms shop door at (9,14).
expect: The shop opens and trades as by day.
No 'THE DOOR IS LOCKED' prompt and no city watch.
sources: [P] §3.0 (qa/research/guides-digest.md) ('The door at (9,14) works at night (a bug)')
scenarios.notes: Faithful-port behaviour; the other shop doors are locked at night.

scenarios.title: Visit the three temples
steps: Enter the Temple of Tyr (location 6): 'THE PRIESTS OF TYR WELCOME YOU TO THE TEMPLE.'
Enter the Temple of Sune (location 7): 'YOU ARE WELCOMED BY PRIESTESS JOY OF SUNE.'
Enter the Temple of Tempus (location 24): 'THE PRIESTS OF TEMPUS BID YOU WELCOME.'
Each asks '' DO YOU SEEK HEALING?''. Choose YES to open the healing services; NO prints 'THEN YOU MUST LEAVE.'
expect: Each temple offers the temple services menu.
All three offer the same services at the same prices (Clue Book).
data: Tyr (6), Sune (7), Tempus (24) are [P] location numbers, not coordinates
Doors the test uses: Sune entered at (1,3) from (1,4); Tyr at (11,3) from (11,2); Tempus at (0,12) from (0,11)

Each temple's Heal list, with prices in gold as the game states them: Cure Blindness 1000, Cure Disease 1000, Cure Light Wounds 100, Cure Serious Wounds 350, Cure Critical Wounds 600, Neutralize Poison 1000, Raise Dead 5500, Remove Curse 3500, Stone to Flesh 2000
disagreements: Clue Book p.3-4 numbers New Phlan 1-24 (for example 3 Temple of Tyr, 5 Dueling & Hiring Hall, 12 City Hall entrance, 13 Clerk, 19 Inns, 20 Taverns); [P] uses different numbers (2 dock, 5 Braccio, 6 Tyr, 7 Sune, 14 hall, 24 Tempus, 26-34 City Hall). The numbers do not line up.
coveredBy: verifySokalTempleHealing (asserts /do you seek healing/; milestone 'Returned to New Phlan and verified Brin's paid temple healing after reloading slot G.')
verifySokalTempleRecovery (milestone 'Raised and healed Brin, readied his mace, and reloaded at the Temple of Tyr:')
scenarios.notes: The digest gives no temple prices or coordinates. [P] §5 notes relevant to temple services: Raise Dead never fails, works on elves, and can drive Constitution down to 0. Established by npm run acceptance:new-phlan: NO prints 'THEN YOU MUST LEAVE.' and puts the party back on the square outside the door. YES opens the menu 'Heal View Pool Appraise Exit'; Heal lists nine cures, and each names its price before asking 'pay for cure' (a healthy character is first asked 'cast cure anyway'). All three temples list the same nine at the same prices, which are the ones in acceptance.mechanics.temple.services. Nothing is bought.

scenarios.title: Dock before Sokal Keep is cleared: one free destination
steps: Walk toward the dock; the game prints 'TO THE NORTH IS THE PASSENGER DOCK.'
At the dock (location 2, (11,1)) the harbor master says ''BY ORDER OF THE CITY COUNCIL,' THE HARBOR MASTER SAYS, 'THE ONLY BOAT OUT IS GOING TO SOKAL KEEP. YOU CAN CATCH IT AT THE END OF THE PIER.''
Board. The game prints 'YOU BOARD A BOAT.'
expect: No destination menu is shown.
No money is charged.
The party arrives at Sokal Keep; the game clock does not advance.
coveredBy: verifySokalArrival
scenarios.notes: The digest does not give the square where the 'PASSENGER DOCK' line prints. Established by npm run acceptance:new-phlan: 'TO THE NORTH IS THE PASSENGER DOCK.' prints on (11,2). On arrival the game prints 'THE BOAT DISEMBARKS YOU AT SOKAL KEEP.' The clock shows only the one minute of the step onto the pier's end square (15,1); the crossing itself adds nothing. No character's coins change.

scenarios.title: Dock after Sokal Keep is cleared: four destinations at 1 platinum
steps: After Sokal Keep is cleared, go to the dock at (11,1).

The harbor master says 'THE HARBOR MASTER TELLS YOU BOATS LEAVE FOR THE WEST, THE EAST, SOKAL KEEP, AND THE NORTH SIDE OF THE BAY. 'ROUND TRIP PASSAGE IS 1 PLATINUM PIECE. WHAT PASSAGE CAN I SELL YOU?'' with the menu SOKAL / EAST / WEST / BAY / NONE.
Choose a destination. He says ''CATCH THE BOAT AT THE END OF THE PIER.''
Board: 'YOU BOARD A BOAT.'
expect: 1 platinum is deducted per trip.
SOKAL -> Sokal Keep (8,14); EAST -> wilderness (35,29); WEST -> wilderness (20,29); BAY -> north side of the bay (26,27).
The game clock does not advance during a boat trip.
NONE: no charge, the party stays.
disagreements: Price wording: game text 'ROUND TRIP PASSAGE IS 1 PLATINUM PIECE'; [P] 'each trip costs 1 platinum'. Whether the return leg is charged again must be read from the scripts of the destination areas.
Clue Book p.3: after Sokal Keep 'you may also take the boat into the wilderness to the east or to the west'; it omits the bay there, but p.8 lists 'the West, the North Bay, or the East'.
scenarios.notes: Overland travel costs 12 hours per square ([P] §4), so 'no game time' for boats is observable on the clock. The digest does not say what happens with less than 1 platinum.

scenarios.title: The river text changes after Yarash is defeated
steps: Before Yarash is defeated walk to location 8 at (1,0). The game prints 'YOU WALK NEAR THE POISONOUS BARREN RIVER.'
After Yarash is defeated (commission #10) walk to (1,0). The game prints 'YOU WALK NEAR THE BEAUTIFUL STOJANOW RIVER.'
expect: The text is selected by the Yarash-defeated state.
scenarios.notes: The digest says 'after Yarash is defeated'; whether the switch is on defeating him or on collecting the #10 reward is not stated. The clerk's reward line spells the river 'STOJONOW' (ECL3.DAX block 8 at 0xa20b) while this text spells it 'STOJANOW'; keep both as found.

scenarios.title: The west gate text and the watch taking Cadorna's treasure
steps: Walk to the west gate E2 (0,4). The game prints 'YOU ARE BY THE GATEWAY TO THE UNSETTLED AREAS. THE CITY WATCH EYES YOU SUSPICIOUSLY.'

Enter New Phlan carrying Cadorna's treasure from the Textile House. The game prints 'THE CITY WATCH STOPS YOU AND REMOVES CADORNA'S TREASURE FROM YOUR KEEPING. THEY TELL YOU YOUR REWARD WAITS WITH THE CITY CLERK.'
expect: The gate text prints at the gate.
With the treasure, it is removed from the party and the #5 reward becomes due at the clerk.
coveredBy: milestone 'Returned from the Textile House via the west ferry, handed off the sealed box, and collected the council reward.'
scenarios.notes: Neither text is in digest §3.0; both are from the game text. The conditions for the treasure hand-off (sealed or opened box, which entrance) belong to the Textile House area (§3.7) and are specified there, not here.

scenarios.title: Fleeing puts the party on one of four squares
steps: Flee from the city guard or another New Phlan encounter (the Run choice).
Read the party position.
scenarios.notes: [P] describes Run as going 'to a random location'; the four flee squares are the stated candidates. The four squares are the script's table (ECL3.DAX block 0, x at b61a: 3, 10, 2, 12; y at b61e: 11, 10, 0, 3), with a random facing (aef7). A run that interrupts a step (the night break-in) then completes that step from the flee square in the new facing, the original's own order (#96, see guard-trigger-closed-building).

scenarios.title: Rest in the street and get rousted by the city watch
steps: Encamp and rest anywhere in New Phlan outside an inn.
The game prints 'YOU ARE ROUSTED BY THE CITY WATCH AND TOLD TO MOVE ALONG. WHAT DO YOU DO?' with the menu GO / STAY (ECL 0) or GO / FIGHT (ECL 11, the training and hall block).
expect: GO: the party moves on with no fight.
STAY or FIGHT: the city guard fight starts (see guard-fight).
disagreements: Menu: [P] gives the choice as 'R'un or 'S'tay; the game text for this trigger is GO / STAY (block 0) and GO / FIGHT (block 11). STAY / RUN is the menu of the brawl and break-in triggers.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say whether GO moves the party to a flee square or simply ends the rest. Established by npm run acceptance:new-phlan: the game's menus are 'Go Stay' in the streets and 'Go Fight' in the training block. GO ends the encounter with the party awake on the square where it camped, unhurt, the rest cut short; it is not moved to a flee square. STAY and FIGHT start a fight (the test stops at the first combat menu). Resting outside an inn always brings the watch: the script sets the interruption chance to 101 (block 0 at 9a7f, block 11 at 9996) unless an inn was paid.

scenarios.title: Break into a shop or City Hall at night
steps: At night (after 14:00) walk into a shop door or a City Hall building.
The game prints 'THE DOOR IS LOCKED. DO YOU WANT TO BREAK IN?' Choose YES.
The game prints 'THE CITY WATCH RESPONDS TO THE NOISE. DO YOU STAY TO FIGHT THEM OR RUN AWAY?' with the menu STAY / RUN.
expect: NO at the door: nothing happens.
STAY: the city guard fight.
RUN: the party is put on a random flee square.
sources: game text ECL3.DAX block 8 at 0x9964 (src/audio/voice-master-manifest.json) ('THE WAY IS BLOCKED.')
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say whether a successful break-in opens the shop. 'THE WAY IS BLOCKED.' in the City Hall block (0x9964) is the likely night message there; its trigger is not described in the digest. Seen in the port on 2026-11-21, not yet in a test: at night, stepping from (10,10) west into the general store door gives the prompt; NO leaves the party where it is; YES then RUN put the party on (3,12) facing south, one square south of the flee square (3,11). The script does not cancel the interrupted step on this path (block 0 sets 0x6dc9 to 255 only for NO, at 99e4). Settled on 2026-11-22 (#96) as the original's own behaviour: the main loop runs the script's step event (GAME.OVR slice 3 +0x3453, call 0x3171) and then the move routine (slice 3 +0x348d, lcall 0072:0025 to slice 14 0xd6d), which moves from the party's position and facing as they are then (slice 14 +0xd92 reads 6aad, 6aae, 6aaf) unless the script set 0x6dc9 to 255. RUN (aef7) sets a flee square and a random facing and leaves 0x6dc9 alone, so the step the party was taking is completed from the flee square in that facing, unless a wall stops it. Traced in the port: RUN, then the move routine entered at (3,11) facing north and the party ended on (3,10); the earlier run drew south and ended on (3,12). So a run that interrupts a step ends on a flee square or one square beyond it.

scenarios.title: Force past the temple guards to Bishop Braccio
steps: Before commission #6 is offered, walk to location 5 at (10,5).
The game prints 'THE TEMPLE GUARDS INFORM YOU THAT THE BISHOP IS NOT RECEIVING VISITORS AT THIS TIME. WHAT DO YOU DO?' with the menu LEAVE / FORCE YOUR WAY PAST.
Choose FORCE YOUR WAY PAST.
expect: LEAVE: nothing happens.
FORCE YOUR WAY PAST: the city guard responds (Run or Stay and fight).

scenarios.title: The MAD MAN attacks citizens
steps: Enter New Phlan with the MAD MAN (#25) from Mendor's Library in the party.
At random the game prints 'THE MAD MAN SUDDENLY BEGINS TO SCREAM AND ATTACK EVERYONE WITHIN ARM'S REACH.'
The city guard responds.
expect: The guard choice (Run, or Stay and fight) is offered.

Elsewhere a priest says 'AN AGED PRIEST APPROACHES, POINTING AT THE MAD MAN, HE SPEAKS, 'THAT MAN URGENTLY NEEDS OUR CARE. DROP HIM FROM YOUR PARTY OR HE WILL BRING YOU TO GRIEF. WE WILL CARE FOR HIM.''
scenarios.notes: The digest gives neither the odds of the outburst nor where the priest appears; the priest's text is from the game text only.

scenarios.title: Stay and fight the city guard
steps: Trigger the city watch and choose to stay.
Fight 2 LEVEL 3 MU (#94), 12 6TH LEVEL FIGHTER (#84), 12 AIDES (#53) and 12 NOMAD (#40).
Win.
expect: Each character gains 5609 XP.
The town is now angry: all shops and temples refuse service (see service-refused-until-rewarded).
fights: 2 LEVEL 3 MU (#94), 12 6TH LEVEL FIGHTER (#84), 12 AIDES (#53), 12 NOMAD (#40); Morale 50; 5609 XP
sources: Clue Book p.3-4 notes ('If you fight any of these guards, you will be unable to buy anything in the shops or temples until you complete a mission')
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say whether merely starting the fight, or winning it, sets the anger.

scenarios.title: Run from the city watch
steps: Trigger the city watch and choose to run.
expect: The party is placed on a random flee square: (3,11), (10,10), (2,0) or (12,3).
No fight; the town does not become angry.
scenarios.notes: 'The town does not become angry' follows from [P] tying the anger to 'after fighting the guard'.

scenarios.title: After fighting the guard, service is refused until a commission is rewarded
steps: After fighting the city guard, enter a shop and a temple.
Each prints ''DUE TO YOUR VICIOUS ATTACK ON THOSE WHO PROTECT US, WE REFUSE YOU ALL SERVICE.''
Collect any commission reward from the clerk (other than Braccio's #6).
Enter the shop and temple again.
expect: While angry, no shop sells or buys and no temple heals.
After a clerk reward the shops and temples serve normally.
The #6 (Braccio) reward does not cancel the anger.
disagreements: Scope: [P] 'all shops and temples refuse service until you are rewarded for a commission'; Clue Book p.3 'unable to buy anything in the shops or temples until you complete a mission'. [P] ties the pardon to collecting the reward, the Clue Book to completing the mission.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say whether training halls, the hiring hall or the dock also refuse. Inns show the refusal but still let the party rest (see inn-denied-but-can-rest).

scenarios.title: The Temple of Tempus attacks an unforgiven party
steps: While the town is angry, enter the Temple of Tempus.
The game prints 'YOU ATTACKED THE CITY WATCH, YOU WON'T BEAT US SO EASILY!'
Fight 12 7TH LVL CLERIC (#83), 20 4TH LVL FIGHTER (#41) and 20 8TH LVL FIGHTER (#85).
Leave and enter again while still unforgiven.
expect: The fight happens on every entry while unforgiven.
fights: 12 7TH LVL CLERIC (#83), 20 4TH LVL FIGHTER (#41), 20 8TH LVL FIGHTER (#85); Morale 99; XP not given
sources: Clue Book p.3-4 notes ('the temple of Tempus is guarded by its own temple guards')

scenarios.title: Fight the City Hall guards at location 34
steps: Without the #15 summons, walk to location 34 at (4,6) in City Hall.
The game prints 'YOU ARE INTERCEPTED BY THE COUNCIL GUARD. 'HALT. YOUR PRESENCE IS NOT AUTHORIZED. LEAVE.' DO YOU LEAVE?' with YES / NO.
Choose NO. Fight 3 LEVEL 3 MU (#94), 6 AIDES (#53), 5 8TH LVL FIGHTER (#85) and [PS] CORPORAL (#54).
Win. The game prints 'THE REMAINING GUARDS DECIDE TO LEAVE YOU ALONE.'
Leave City Hall and return to (4,6).
expect: YES: the party is turned back with no fight.
The guards respawn: the intercept happens again on a later visit.
Fighting them counts as fighting guards: service is refused until a commission is rewarded.
fights: 3 LEVEL 3 MU (#94), 6 AIDES (#53), 5 8TH LVL FIGHTER (#85), [PS] CORPORAL (#54); Morale 99; XP not given. The number of CORPORALs equals Party Strength.
sources: Clue Book p.3-4 notes ('The chambers of the city council are guarded by the council guards')
scenarios.notes: '[PS] CORPORAL' is read as a count equal to Party Strength; the digest does not spell that out. That fighting the council guard sets the same anger is stated by the Clue Book ('If you fight any of these guards') and not separately by [P].

scenarios.title: Kill the guards for loot, then clear the anger with a reward
steps: Hold a completed but uncollected commission.
Fight and beat the city guard or the City Hall guards.
Take the loot; an 8TH LVL FIGHTER carries a Ring of Protection +3.
Collect the commission reward from the clerk.
expect: The guards' items can be looted.
After the reward, shops and temples serve again.
scenarios.notes: The digest names only the ring as an example of 'good loot'. A test should assert the ring on a looted 8TH LVL FIGHTER and the pardon, not a full loot table.

scenarios.title: After victory, some offences may be tolerated
steps: Win the game (defeat Tyranthraxus).
Rest outside an inn; force the way to Braccio's office; enter a closed shop.
expect: [P]: triggers (1)-(3) 'may be tolerated after you have won the game'.
scenarios.notes: The digest says 'may be', so it is not checkable as written: a test author must read the victory-flag checks in the ECL 0 script to decide which of the three stop calling the watch. Recorded so the behaviour is not forgotten.

scenarios.title: Tavern: the pickpocket
steps: Enter a tavern (TA). The game prints 'YOU ARE IN A TAVERN. THE AIR IS FILLED WITH SMOKE AND GOSSIP. PEOPLE ARE GAMBLING AT THE TABLES.'
With chance 26 in 256 a pickpocket strikes.
Half the time the party notices: 'YOU FEEL A LIGHT TOUCH ON YOUR PURSE. DO YOU IGNORE IT OR GRAB THE OFFENDING HAND?' with the menu IGNORE / GRAB.
Otherwise: 'YOU REALIZE YOU HAVE BEEN VICTIMIZED BY A PICKPOCKET.'
expect: Robbed: the whole party loses 20% of its money and 5% of its light items.
GRAB: a tavern brawl starts (see tavern-brawl).
Noticing happens 1 time in 2.
sources: [P] §5 quirks (qa/research/guides-digest.md) (theft protection; item theft sources; opcode 28 ROB bug)
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say what IGNORE does (whether the theft then succeeds) or whether GRAB prevents the loss. [P] §5: heavy items at the top of the inventory reduce item theft; opcode 28 mishandles the item chance while iterating; keep both. With fixed dice all three rolls can be asserted.

scenarios.title: Tavern: gamble on the top
steps: In the tavern the game asks 'DOES ANYONE WANT TO GAMBLE?' Choose YES and pick a character.

The game prints ''THE GAME WORKS LIKE THIS. WE SPIN THIS TOP. IF THE GREEN SIDE COMES UP, YOU GET DOUBLE YOUR MONEY BACK. IF A BLUE SIDE COMES UP, YOU GET YOUR MONEY BACK. IF A RED SIDE COMES UP, YOU LOSE.''
It shows 'YOU HAVE <n> PP.' and asks 'HOW MANY PLATINUM PIECES WILL YOU WAGER? (HOUSE LIMIT IS 1000)'.
Enter a wager. One of: 'IT'S GREEN. YOU GET DOUBLE YOUR MONEY BACK.' / 'IT'S BLUE. YOU WIN.' / 'RED. SORRY, YOU LOSE.'
The game asks 'WILL YOU GO AGAIN?'
expect: Red 30%: the wager is lost.
Green 20%: profit equal to the wager.
Blue (the remaining 50%): the wager is returned.
No brawl can happen on a visit where someone gambled.
A wager of 0, above 1000, or above the character's platinum: 'I CAN'T ACCEPT THAT WAGER.', and in version 1.3 the game then asks 'WILL YOU GO AGAIN?'
branches: A character in bad shape cannot play: 'NO ONE IS WILLING TO GAMBLE WITH SOMEONE WHO LOOKS THAT BAD.' (exact condition not in the digest).
disagreements: Blue: the rules text says 'IF A BLUE SIDE COMES UP, YOU GET YOUR MONEY BACK' but the result line reads 'IT'S BLUE. YOU WIN.' [P] gives only red 30% and green 20%, which leaves 50% for blue with no gain.
scenarios.notes: Established by npm run acceptance:new-phlan with the dice trace: the three refusals are in the script (ECL3.DAX block 0 at a56a to a589: wager above the platinum held, above 1000, or 0), and a refused wager draws no die. A spin is one draw from ten numbers (RANDOM 9 at a58d): 8 and 9 are green, 3 to 7 blue, 0 to 2 red, which is 20%, 50% and 30%. Green adds the wager to the gambler's platinum, blue leaves it unchanged although the line reads 'YOU WIN', red takes the wager; the test follows 'YOU HAVE <n> PP.' round by round and reads the character sheet at the end. Declining another spin ends the visit with no tale and no brawl (a643 GOTO ae6d). 1.3-specific: after 'I CAN'T ACCEPT THAT WAGER.' the script goes on to 'WILL YOU GO AGAIN?' (a692 GOTO a609); the first release has EXIT there and leaves the tavern script. This instruction, not the brawl, is the three-byte edit in qa/research/version-1.3-differences.md.

scenarios.title: Tavern: overhear one of 23 tales
steps: In the tavern the game prints 'YOU OVERHEAR TAVERN TALE <n>'.
Repeat visits and record the numbers.
expect: n is always between 1 and 23.
Tale 24 is never announced in 1.3.
Only the number is shown; the tale text is printed in the Adventurer's Journal p.33-34, not on screen.
data: Useful tales per [P]: 1 (wizard's castle ruins in a swamp far to the northeast), 3 (wells give access to hidden dens and underground passages), 8 (the graveyard is controlled by a powerful undead), 23 (silver dragon in the Dragonspine Mountains who helps travellers); 9 (manuscript dated 1977 GUE) for breaking the fourth wall
All 23 tales: Adventurer's Journal p.33-34 (summaries in NOTES.md)
sources: Clue Book: Tavern Tale 23 is the silver dragon (digest [CB])
scenarios.notes: 1.3-specific: the first release drew 1-24 and could announce a non-existent Tale 24; 1.3 draws 1-23 (qa/research/version-1.3-differences.md: operand RANDOM 17 -> RANDOM 16 at script address a429). The digest does not say how often a tale is heard per visit or how it combines with the pickpocket and brawl rolls. Established by npm run acceptance:new-phlan with the dice trace: on a visit where nobody gambles the party always overhears one tale (a407 to a438). The number is the first draw after the answer, from 23 numbers, plus one (RANDOM 22 at a429; the first release has RANDOM 23), so 24 cannot come up. After the tale one draw in four starts the brawl (a440: RANDOM 3, value 1). The pickpocket roll comes first on every entry (a328).

scenarios.title: Tavern: the drunken brawl
steps: Visit a tavern without gambling; a brawl starts 1 time in 4 (or always after GRAB on a pickpocket).
The game prints 'A DRUNKEN BRAWL BREAKS OUT. YOU ARE CAUGHT IN THE MIDDLE.'
Roll 1d2, +1 if Party Strength is 25 or more, +2 if 51 or more. Starting at that number, fight 11 of each of three consecutive groups from the list in data.
13 allies join the party's side; 1d4 picks their type.
Win. The game prints 'THE CITY WATCH CHARGES IN. DO YOU RUN AWAY OR STAY TO CONFRONT THEM?' with the menu STAY / RUN.
expect: Enemies: 33 in three groups of 11, Morale 50.
13 allies fight for the party.
Winning gives no items.
After the win the city watch confronts the party: STAY leads to the city guard fight, RUN to a flee square.
fights: 11 each of three consecutive entries starting at 1d2 (+1 at PS>=25, +2 at PS>=51): 1 NOMAD (#40), 2 1ST LVL THIEF (#45), 3 CORPORAL (#54), 4 AIDES (#53), 5 4TH LVL FIGHTER (#41), 6 6TH LVL THIEF (#51); Morale 50; 13 allies
sources: Clue Book p.3-4 location 20 ('brawls (which are worth experience points)')
disagreements: Clue Book p.4: brawls 'are worth experience points'; [P]: 'If you win you get no items, and then the city guard confront you'. [P] does not give the brawl's XP.
[P] counts 'tavern brawling' as city-guard trigger (4); the game text shows the watch arriving only after the brawl ('THE CITY WATCH CHARGES IN').
scenarios.notes: Corrected from the script (src/lib/ecl.ts on ECL3.DAX block 0 of both releases): the brawl is the same in 1.3 and the first release. The instruction that differs, at a692, is the last one of the refused wager ('I CAN'T ACCEPT THAT WAGER.': EXIT in the first release, GOTO a609 in 1.3); the brawl starts at the instruction after it (a696 in 1.3, a693 in the first release). After a won brawl both releases print 'THE CITY WATCH CHARGES IN.' with STAY / RUN (a7e5); a7d6 tests the result of the fight first and can go straight to the flee squares. The digest does not say which ally types the 1d4 selects. Maximum start index is 4 (2+2), so groups 4-6 at the top.

scenarios.title: Read the proclamations at the City Hall entrance
steps: Walk to the City Hall entrance (location 26). The game prints 'YOU ARE OUTSIDE THE CITY HALL. THE CITY CLERK WAITS INSIDE TO AWARD COMMISSIONS.'
The game prints 'PROCLAMATIONS ARE POSTED ON THE WALLS, IN YOUR JOURNAL YOU NOTE' followed by the current proclamation numbers.
With 0 tracker quests the line is 'PROCLAMATIONS LXIV, LXXVIII, CIX, AND LIX.'
With 1 to 10 tracker quests the line is 'PROCLAMATION <numeral>' (or the pair for 2 quests), per the table in data.
Complete tracker quests one at a time and re-read the wall after each.
expect: The numerals shown match the row for the current tracker count.
Each numeral is a proclamation printed in the Adventurer's Journal p.13-15.
data: 0 tracker quests: LXIV (Valhingen Graveyard information); LXXVIII (Valhingen Graveyard information); CIX (rescue force for Taimalg-the-Invincible, lost in Valhingen); LIX (clear any block)
2 tracker quests: CXXVI (books and tomes); CX (special commission, 'political sensitivity')
4 tracker quests: CLIV (bounty per undead plus an enchanted item for Valhingen)
5 tracker quests: CXIV (heir of House Bivant)
8 tracker quests: CCI (lizard men to the east)
9 tracker quests: CXIV (heir of House Bivant)

Journal proclamations never posted per [P]'s table: CXX (pirates' stronghold in the Twilight Marsh), CLVI (rescue the Duchess of Melvaunt from ogres), CLXX (insect men west of New Phlan), CXC (hobgoblins gathering), CCXIV (nomads)
disagreements: Coverage: the Journal prints 18 proclamations; [P]'s table posts only 13 distinct ones and never CXX, CLVI, CLXX, CXC or CCXIV.

Repeats: [P]'s table lists LIX at 0 and at 10 quests, and CXIV at 5 and at 9. A repeated CXIV at 9 may be a transcription slip for one of the five never-posted numerals (the Journal's CCXIV differs from CXIV by a leading 'C'); the digest gives no evidence either way.

Order vs content: CXIV (heir of Bivant) is posted at 5 quests, but commission #12 (the heir) is twelfth on the clerk's list; CCIV (kobolds) is posted at 6 and CCI (lizard men) at 8, while nomads (commission #8, Journal CCXIV) are never posted. The wall and the clerk's list are not in step in [P].

Clue Book p.3-4 numbers New Phlan 1-24 (for example 3 Temple of Tyr, 5 Dueling & Hiring Hall, 12 City Hall entrance, 13 Clerk, 19 Inns, 20 Taverns); [P] uses different numbers (2 dock, 5 Braccio, 6 Tyr, 7 Sune, 14 hall, 24 Tempus, 26-34 City Hall). The numbers do not line up. Clue Book: entrance is 12; [P]: 26.
scenarios.notes: Only row 0 is confirmed by the game text ('PROCLAMATIONS LXIV, LXXVIII, CIX, AND LIX.' at 0xac9b). Rows 1-10 are built at run time from 'PROCLAMATION' + a numeral (0xac8a, 0xac96), so the manifest cannot confirm them: read the numeral table from the script and compare it with [P] before asserting rows 5 and 9. The 2-quest row has two numerals but the script's stem is singular; the exact wording is not known from the digest. The digest gives no coordinates for location 26. Read from the script (ECL3.DAX block 0 at ac58 to ad2b): tracker 0 prints 'PROCLAMATIONS LXIV, LXXVIII, CIX, AND LIX.'; 1 to 9 print 'PROCLAMATION' followed by CI. / CXXVI AND CX. / CXXXIV. / CLIV. / CXIV. / CCIV. / CXXIX. / CCI. / CXIV.; 10 or more leaves the preset 'LIX.' (aba0). That is [P]'s table, repeats included, and the 2-quest wording is 'PROCLAMATIONCXXVI AND CX.' as the script builds it (no space is stored after the stem; check the screen before asserting spacing). npm run acceptance:new-phlan asserts row 0 on the wall, read from (3,4) facing the west door of City Hall.

scenarios.title: Skullcrusher leaves the party at the City Hall entrance
steps: Arrive at location 26 with Skullcrusher (from the Textile House) in the party.
The game prints 'SKULLCRUSHER SPEAKS, 'I MUST GO TO MY MASTER NOW.'' and 'HE LEAVES.'
expect: Skullcrusher is removed from the party.

scenarios.title: Enter City Hall and see the guarded door
steps: Enter City Hall by day. The game prints 'YOU ENTER THE CITY HALL. AS YOU FACE DOWN THE HALLWAY, YOU SEE A GUARDED DOOR.'
Walk to the clerk's door. The game prints 'YOU ARE OUTSIDE THE CLERK'S OFFICE. GUARDS POSTED AROUND A DOOR IN THE SOUTH WALL WATCH YOU CLOSELY.'
expect: Both texts print on the way to location 29 (5,5).

scenarios.title: Cadorna confronts a party that opened his treasure
steps: Open the Cadorna treasure box in an obvious way (Textile House), then walk to location 27 at (4,4).
The game prints 'COUNCILMAN CADORNA CONFRONTS YOU. 'YOU HAVE TAKEN MY FAMILY TREASURE. I DON'T FORGET SUCH THINGS.' HE STRIDES OFF.'
expect: The text prints only if the box was opened in an obvious way.
No fight.
disagreements: Opening the box: [GB] 'you won't get a reward'; [P] you get the contents, 1943 XP and Cadorna's anger, the #5 reward not explicitly denied; Clue Book: the clerk pays only if the box was not 'obviously' opened (digest §7 item 15).
coveredBy: milestone 'Returned with the opened box and reloaded Cadorna's unpaid outcome.'

scenarios.title: The clerk checks rewards, then offers the first three unresolved commissions
steps: Enter location 29 at (5,5). The clerk says 'AT YOUR ENTRY, THE COUNCIL CLERK BEGINS LOOKING THROUGH A STACK OF PAPERS. 'BEFORE I CAN OFFER ANY COMMISSIONS, I MUST SEE IF YOU ARE DUE A CURRENT REWARD.'
Any rewards due are paid first, each with 'THE CLERK SPEAKS. '' ... 'HERE IS YOUR REWARD.''

Then 'THE CLERK SHUFFLES THROUGH HER PAPERS. 'ON THE MATTER OF COMMISSION,' SHE SAYS, 'I CAN OFFER THE FOLLOWING: '' and up to three offers, in list order, skipping resolved ones and ones whose prerequisite is unmet.
She ends with ''THESE ARE ALL OF THE COMMISSIONS CURRENTLY AVAILABLE.''

Leave the office (step west to (4,5)) and come straight back: she says ''BACK SO SOON? I CAN ONLY REPEAT THE EARLIER OFFERS: '' and then only ''THESE ARE ALL OF THE COMMISSIONS CURRENTLY AVAILABLE.'': no offer is named again.
expect: At most three commissions are offered per visit, the first three unresolved on the fixed list of 15.
Rewards are paid before offers.
A mission completed without having been offered is still rewarded ('In most cases').
data: Prerequisites per [P]: #5 needs #2; #7 needs #2; #12 must be offered and needs #2; #13 needs #5; #14 needs #13; #15 needs #14; #4 must be offered first; #6 is asked only once
sources: Clue Book p.3-4 notes and location 13
disagreements: Order of offers: [GB] after 2 quests -> Cadorna, after 3 -> Braccio, about a dozen -> Cadorna's chambers; [P] the first three unresolved commissions from a fixed list, #5 needs #2 (digest §7 item 16).
Clue Book p.3: 'she will describe several commissions'; [P]: exactly the first three unresolved.

Clue Book p.3-4 numbers New Phlan 1-24 (for example 3 Temple of Tyr, 5 Dueling & Hiring Hall, 12 City Hall entrance, 13 Clerk, 19 Inns, 20 Taverns); [P] uses different numbers (2 dock, 5 Braccio, 6 Tyr, 7 Sune, 14 hall, 24 Tempus, 26-34 City Hall). The numbers do not line up. Clue Book: clerk is 13; [P]: 29.
coveredBy: verifySokalArrival
verifySokalRestoredCouncil (milestone 'Heard and tracked the Sokal commission, then returned to Thorn Island:')
verifyPodalFromCouncil
scenarios.notes: [P] names the clerk Sasha only 'in later games'; the game text calls her 'THE COUNCIL CLERK'. The digest does not say whether a commission with an unmet prerequisite is skipped or blocks the list; 'skipping' above is the reading that fits 'first three unresolved' plus the prerequisites, and must be confirmed in the script. What triggers 'BACK SO SOON?' (same visit, or no change in state) is not stated. Corrected from the game (npm run acceptance:new-phlan, which walks this part but does not prove the scenario): 'BACK SO SOON?' is the clerk's answer on any later entry to (5,5) during the same stay in City Hall (her visited flag 0x4a01, block 8 at 9ba1), and she then repeats nothing, because the count of offers made (0x4a05) is still 3 and the loop ends at once (a845). The first visit offered exactly three. Skipping is confirmed in the script: a resolved commission or one whose condition fails jumps to the next list entry without counting (a89e).

scenarios.title: Junior Councilman's office: barred, then Cadorna's commission
steps: Before commission #5 is offered, walk to location 30 at (6,5): a guard bars the way.
After the clerk says 'JUNIOR COUNCILMAN CADORNA HAS A SPECIAL COMMISSION FOR YOU. HIS CHAMBERS ARE THROUGH THE EAST DOOR.'', enter (6,5).

Cadorna says ''WHEN OLD PHLAN WAS OVERRUN, A FAMILY TREASURE WAS HIDDEN IN THE WESTERN BUILDING OF THE TEXTILE COMPLEX.' then ''THE FAITHFUL SERVANT SENT TO FETCH IT NEVER RETURNED. THE COMPLEX IS JUST SOUTH OF PODOL PLAZA. BRING THE TREASURE TO ME AND YOU WILL BE WELL REWARDED.''

After the speech commission #5 is accepted.

Clue Book p.3-4 numbers New Phlan 1-24 (for example 3 Temple of Tyr, 5 Dueling & Hiring Hall, 12 City Hall entrance, 13 Clerk, 19 Inns, 20 Taverns); [P] uses different numbers (2 dock, 5 Braccio, 6 Tyr, 7 Sune, 14 hall, 24 Tempus, 26-34 City Hall). The numbers do not line up.
coveredBy: verifyPodalFromCouncil (milestone 'Verified the Podal Plaza exchange, council reward, and Textile House commission after reload.')

scenarios.title: Senior Councilman's office: barred, then the Zhentil packet
steps: Before commission #13 is offered, walk to location 31 at (5,6): entry is barred.
After the clerk says 'LORD CADORNA HAS A DELICATE DIPLOMATIC MISSION THAT REQUIRES YOUR PARTICULAR SKILLS. YOU ARE SUMMONED TO HIS CHAMBERS. GO THROUGH THE SOUTH DOOR.'', enter (5,6).

Cadorna says ''IT IS IMPERATIVE THAT A MESSAGE BE DELIVERED TO THE ZHENTIL OUTPOST TO THE WEST. I AM SENDING YOU AS DIPLOMATIC ENVOYS.' then ''WHEN YOU GET TO ZHENTIAL KEEP, PRESENT THIS PACKET TO ITS COMMANDANT. DO NOT BREAK THE SEALS OR YOU WILL BE SEIZED AS SPIES.''
Look for the packet in the inventories and try to open it.

BE CAREFUL, THE TRAITOR CADORNA MAY HAVE TAMPERED WITH THE MESSAGE PACKET BEFORE HE FLED.'' and this office is not used.
disagreements: Clue Book p.3-4 numbers New Phlan 1-24 (for example 3 Temple of Tyr, 5 Dueling & Hiring Hall, 12 City Hall entrance, 13 Clerk, 19 Inns, 20 Taverns); [P] uses different numbers (2 dock, 5 Braccio, 6 Tyr, 7 Sune, 14 hall, 24 Tempus, 26-34 City Hall). The numbers do not line up.

scenarios.title: Head Councilman's office: Urslingen and Stojanow Gate
steps: Before the #13 reward is collected, location 32 is not available.
After the #13 reward the clerk says 'LORD URSLINGEN WISHES URGENTLY TO SPEAK WITH YOU. GO THROUGH THE SOUTH DOOR OF THE TRAITOR CADORNA'S OLD QUARTERS.''

TO DO THIS, WE MUST FIRST SECURE STOJANOW GATE.' then ''THE GATE IS TOO STRONG TO BE TAKEN BY STORM. A SMALL BAND MUST SLIP INSIDE AND HOLD UNTIL RELIEVED. YOU ARE THE BEST AND THE BRAVEST. THE COUNCIL HAS INSTRUCTED ME TO ENTRUST THE TASK TO YOU.''
expect: Location 32 opens only after the #13 reward.
After the speech commission #14 is accepted.
sources: Adventurer's Journal p.27 entry 38 (facts and rumours on Werner von Urslingen)

scenarios.title: Council chambers: the assault on Valjevo Castle
steps: Before the #14 reward is collected, location 33 is not available and the guards at 34 (4,6) bar the way.

scenarios.title: Bishop Braccio's study: barred, then Dirten joins
steps: Before commission #6 is offered, the temple guards at location 5 (10,5) refuse entry (LEAVE / FORCE YOUR WAY PAST).
After the clerk says 'YOU ARE SUMMONED BY THE BISHOP OF BRACCIO OF TYR. REPORT TO HIM AT TYR'S TEMPLE.'', go to (10,5).

The game prints 'YOU ARE USHERED INTO THE BISHOP'S STUDY. BISHOP BRACCIO SPEAKS, 'ALLOW ME TO INTRODUCE DIRTEN, PRIEST OF ILMAR.' then ''HE IS BOUND TO RECOVER THE TEMPLE WHICH HAS BEEN DESECRATED TO BANE. GO WITH HIM ACROSS THE RIVER AND HELP HIM TO CLEANSE THE TEMPLE. IN PAYMENT, YOU MAY KEEP THE HIDDEN TREASURES.'' and ''WILL YOU ACCOMPANY DIRTEN?''
Choose YES.
expect: DIRTEN (#107), Morale 99, joins the party as an NPC.
Commission #6 is accepted.
branches: Party full: ''YOUR PARTY IS TOO LARGE TO JOIN AT THIS TIME. RETURN WHEN IT IS SMALLER.''
Return later without Dirten: 'YOU ARE USHERED INTO THE STUDY WHERE DIRTEN WAITS. 'I AM ABOUT TO JOURNEY TO THE TEMPLE, WILL YOU COME WITH ME?''
Force the way in before #6: the city guard responds (see guard-trigger-forcing-braccio).
sources: Adventurer's Journal p.31 entry 51 (facts and rumours on Bishop Braccio)

scenarios.title: Hired NPCs: claimed share, actual share and documented defects
steps: Hire a THEURGIST, ROBBER, CURATE or EVOKER and note the share quoted in the offer.
Win a fight with coin treasure and compare the NPC's cut with the quote.
Win a fight with item treasure.
Try to take an item from a conscious NPC; then from one who is down.
expect: The share actually taken is 7 for THEURGIST, ROBBER, CURATE and EVOKER, whatever was quoted (4, 3, 3 and 2).
SWORDSMAN, WARRIOR, ACOLYTE and HERO take what they quote (3, 1, 1, 4).
NPCs never actually take items, even those whose offer claims items.
Items can be taken from an NPC only while it is down.
The ACOLYTE's race is 'Monster' and he has 0 XP, so he can be 'M'odified.
